steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and use lot awarding.
Provide the required project title before publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields for the added line item.
Set the requested delivery location.
Upload the attachment that should remain.
Upload a second attachment that will be removed.

args.goal: Remove the sample.png attachment using its delete control and leave the create screen showing sample.pdf listed while sample.png is absent

steps.note: Exercise and verify the attachment removal control, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add the named vendor to the event.
Commit the default 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ and confirm the publish dialog.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Confirm the remaining attachment is listed on the buyer's project details.
Confirm the removed attachment is not listed on the buyer's project details.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the published event's vendor overview where shared attachments are visible.
Verify the remaining attachment is visible to the vendor.
Verify the removed attachment is not visible to the vendor.
